title: The Automation Framework add-on
description: How the automation add-on began in January 2021, which jobs and add-ons joined it, its use in Docker scripts and the Retest add-on, and its 2026 state, according to commits and CHANGELOGs.

chapters.title: First phase, January 2021
chapters.text: The commit "Automation add-on - first phase" (2021-01-14) adds addOns/automation with AutomationEnvironment, AutomationJob, ExtensionAutomation, and two jobs, AddOnJob and PassiveScanConfigJob. "Automation: Support active scan" follows on 2021-02-23. The CHANGELOG dates 0.0.1 ("First version.") to 2021-03-09, and "Weekly - add automation and reports" in zaproxy is dated the same day.

chapters.title: Other add-ons gain jobs in 2021
chapters.text: Commit subjects show add-ons adding Automation Framework support: "Ajax Spider - add automation framework support" (2021-02-19), "OpenAPI: Automation Framework Support" (2021-03-05), "soap: Support Automation Framework" (2021-03-16), "graphql: Add Automation Framework Support" (2021-03-22) and "alertFilter: support automation framework" (2021-09-13). The automation CHANGELOG lists 0.3.0 (2021-06-28) with "A new Requestor job to make specific requests." and 0.8.0 (2021-11-02) with "Delay job". The scripts CHANGELOG lists "Automation ScriptJob - Add or remove any script and run a standalone script" under version 30 (2022-02-25).

chapters.title: Docker packaged scans and the Retest add-on
chapters.text: In zaproxy, "Use the auto framework for simple baseline scans" (2021-05-25) changes docker/zap-baseline.py and the Dockerfiles. "Docker: change packaged scans to always update all add-on on start" (2021-10-08) has the body "This is to avoid a bug in the automation framework breaking plans", and "Docker: Automation Framework plan tests" is dated 2021-11-02. In zap-extensions, the Retest add-on starts with "Initial addon" (2021-08-20), and the automation CHANGELOG for 0.5.0 (2021-08-23) lists "Changes to support the Retest add-on."

chapters.title: ZAP 2.11.0 and the blog, October 2021
chapters.text: The post "ZAP 2.11.0" (2021-10-07, "the OWASP 20th anniversary release") lists the Automation Framework as new: "The Automation Framework is a new way to automate ZAP and is expected to become the default option for most automation use cases." It says it can be used from the command line and that the desktop can generate and test plans. In the same release the Docker stable and bare images "will now be updated monthly, typically around the start of the month", and the post says the packaged scans are being migrated to the Automation Framework, which matches the commits above.

chapters.title: GUI, authentication, and beta status
chapters.text: The CHANGELOG records "First phase of GUI" in 0.4.0 (2021-08-05), "User and HTTP authentication support" and "Set ZAP exit code when "-cmd " and "-autorun " options used" in 0.8.0 (2021-11-02), and, in 0.11.0 (2022-01-19), "Form and JSON-based authentication support" and "Promoted to beta". Script authentication support appears in 0.12.0 (2022-02-01).

chapters.title: Jobs move into the add-ons that own them
chapters.text: The CHANGELOG for 0.19.0 (2022-10-27) says "The spider job was removed, it is provided by the Spider add-on (Issue 3113)." 0.42.0 (2024-09-02) says "Rely on Passive Scanner add-on for the passive scan related jobs (Issue 7959)." and deprecates the classes of the passive scan related jobs, and 0.44.0 (2025-01-09) lists "Remove job implementations that were previously migrated to the Passive Scanner add-on (Issue 7959)." The same 0.44.0 entry adds "Active scan policy job.", "Add job to configure the active scanner, `activeScan-config`.", and "Add exitStatus job (Issue #6928)".

chapters.title: Stopping, authentication jobs, and AI assisted authentication
chapters.text: The 0.52.0 entry (2025-09-02) lists "Support for step delay in Browser Based Authentication.", "Support for min wait for in Client Script Authentication.", and "Support for stopping plans and jobs." 0.59.0 (2026-04-02) lists "Allow to load a plan from the contents of the clipboard." and "Move the Automation panel to the workspace window." 0.62.0 (2026-11-03) lists "Support for AI assisted authentication."
